set.title: Recycled Plastic Paving Blocks
set.topicCategory: IELTS Academic Task 1 / Linear process diagram
set.intendedMeaning: Discarded plastic bottles pass through twelve main stages and are converted into tested paving blocks.
set.protectedContent: Twelve-stage process; thirty minutes; 80°C; 180°C; three parts plastic to one part sand; twelve tonnes; five minutes; groups of twenty; approximately six hours

passages.fully_minimally_corrected:
The diagram illustrates how discarded plastic bottles are converted into paving blocks through a twelve-stage linear process. Overall, the procedure begins with the collection and inspection of used bottles and ends with the packaging of tested blocks. Most stages are mechanical, although heat is applied during melting and the material is left to cool before testing.
First, bottles are collected from households and transported to a recycling facility. On arrival, each bottle is inspected to determine whether it contains unsuitable material. Rejected items are removed from the production line, while the acceptable bottles travel along a conveyor belt. Labels and caps are then removed, after which the bottles undergo washing with hot water and detergent.
Once they are clean, the bottles are sent for shredding. Rotating blades cut them into small flakes, which subsequently pass beneath a magnet so that any metal fragments can be extracted. The flakes are dried for thirty minutes at 80 degrees Celsius before entering a heated chamber. This chamber, which is capable of reaching 180 degrees Celsius, melts the flakes into a uniform liquid.
Next, the molten plastic is combined with recycled sand in a ratio of three parts plastic to one part sand. Mechanical paddles continuously stir the two ingredients, preventing heavier particles from settling at the bottom of the tank. The resulting mixture is poured into rectangular moulds whose inner surfaces have been coated with oil to prevent sticking.
After the moulds have been filled, they are compressed under a pressure of twelve tonnes for five minutes. The blocks are then left to cool at room temperature until they have completely solidified. Once solid, they are removed from the moulds, and their edges are trimmed to produce an even shape.
Before the dried flakes enter the chamber, a sensor records their moisture level and diverts any batch that remains too wet. During moulding, excess mixture spilling over the sides is scraped off and returned to the tank. A technician also records the temperature, pressure and processing time for each batch. These records accompany the finished blocks to the testing area, where inspectors compare the results with the factory standard before authorising the batch for storage and delivery.
Each block is subsequently subjected to two quality-control tests. The first measures whether the block can support the required load, while the second checks its resistance to water. Any block that fails either test is returned to the melting stage for reprocessing. Blocks that pass both tests are marked with their production date and packed in groups of twenty.
Finally, the packaged blocks are placed on pallets, wrapped in protective film and stored in a dry warehouse. They remain there until they are transported to construction sites. The complete process takes approximately six hours, excluding the time required to collect the bottles. Wastewater generated during washing is filtered and reused, while damaged moulds are repaired separately. Thus, although the procedure is linear, some rejected material and water are returned to earlier stages instead of being discarded.

sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: illustrate 後面可直接接由 how 引出的內容分句，不同時使用 that how。對照：illustrates that the process is efficient。

sourceIssues.replacementLabel: begins with the collection and inspection of
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 描述程序的第一個階段，常用 begin with + 名詞／動名詞。begin from 通常引出時間或空間起點。
描述最後階段用 end with + 名詞／動名詞。end by doing 可表示最終採取的行為，但本句是在命名階段。
are 是連繫動詞，後面使用形容詞 mechanical 描述 stages，不用副詞 mechanically。
heat 是被施加的事物，所以使用現在被動語態 is applied。
表示讓材料自行冷卻，用 leave + 物件 + to + 動詞原形。leave something cooling 在特定動態語境可能成立，但不是本程序的預定階段寫法。
表示物品的來源，用 collect from + 地點／人。out of 強調從內部移出。
to 引出運送目的地；at 表示物件已位於該地點。
表示檢查的目的，用 to + 動詞原形：inspected to determine...。
remove + 物件 + from + 地點 表示把某物從一處移走。
物件沿着輸送帶移動，用 along。through 表示從某空間或通道內部穿過。
after which 指回前面的整個步驟，並連接下一個完整分句。也可使用句號後另寫 After that, ...。

sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示接受某種加工過程時，可寫 undergo washing/testing/treatment。若指一次獨立的清洗，可寫 undergo a wash。
用甚麼物質清洗，使用 with。by 可引出執行者或方法，如 washed by a machine。
once 後可接完整分句 once they are clean，或縮減為 once clean。once cleaning 會錯誤地表示瓶子主動清洗其他東西。
for 是介詞，後面的動作用動名詞：sent for shredding。另一個正確寫法是 sent to be shredded。
把一個物件切成多個部分，用 cut + 物件 + into + 部分。
beneath 已直接表示從磁鐵下方經過，不再加入 through。

each 後面接單數可數名詞。

to 表示實際到達指定終點；towards 只表示朝某方向移動，未必到達。
prior 若作介詞短語，必須寫 prior to + 動名詞。較簡單的寫法是 before authorising。
表示物件接受測試，用動詞被動結構 be subjected to。be subject to 也可表示受某條件支配，但不用 for。
